categories.main_business_segments: Chiyoda Integre operates primarily in the manufacturing and sale of mechanical and functional components for OA equipment, AV equipment, communication devices, and automobiles. The company is organized into four geographic segments: Japan, Southeast Asia, China, and Other regions (including North America and Europe). Additionally, its subsidiary Sunfelt Co., Ltd. handles processed felt products for handicrafts and fashion accessories.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technology is 'soft press' processing, which enables precision cutting, laminating, and assembly of various materials for electronic and automotive components. It emphasizes advanced film processing, including the development of LCP (liquid crystal polymer) films for heat resistance and low dielectric applications, as well as multi-material integration and high-precision assembly techniques.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Chiyoda Integre's main customers are major electronics and electrical equipment manufacturers, including those in the OA (office automation), AV (audio-visual), communications, and automotive industries. Its products are used as components in end products such as printers, copiers, audio equipment, communication devices, and automobiles, serving both Japanese and global manufacturers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global footprint with operations in Japan, Southeast Asia (notably Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Vietnam, and the Philippines), China (including Hong Kong and several mainland cities), North America (USA, Mexico), and Europe (Slovakia, Germany). Its production and sales network is especially strong in Asia, but it is expanding in North America and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chiyoda Integre operates midstream in the supply chain, supplying processed components and modules to OEMs and manufacturers of finished electronic and automotive products. It does not produce raw materials but adds value through processing, assembly, and integration of materials into functional parts.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus is on expanding high value-added businesses, particularly in automotive and next-generation communication (5G) markets. R&D efforts are directed at developing advanced materials (such as LCP films for heat and electromagnetic compatibility), improving gross margins and unit prices, and investing in infrastructure and employee skill development. Sustainability, including carbon neutrality and resource efficiency, is also a key theme.
categories.revenue_model: Chiyoda Integre generates revenue primarily through the sale of manufactured components and modules to B2B customers. It also receives royalties from group companies for technology and brand usage, and earns additional income from processed felt product sales via its subsidiary.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with other global and regional component manufacturers serving the electronics and automotive sectors. While specific competitors are not named, Chiyoda Integre positions itself as a global leader in soft press technology and high-mix, low-volume production, with a strong reputation among Japanese and international OEMs.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending December 2024, consolidated net sales were 41.2 billion yen, with operating profit of 3.86 billion yen and net profit attributable to parent company shareholders of 3.23 billion yen. The company has shown steady growth in sales and profitability, with a strong equity ratio (81%) and a workforce of approximately 2,950 employees. The medium-term plan targets further growth to 45 billion yen in sales and 4.25 billion yen in operating profit by 2027.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chiyoda Integre differentiates itself through its proprietary soft press technology, enabling high-precision, multi-material processing and assembly for complex electronic and automotive components. The company emphasizes its ability to deliver high value-added, customized solutions globally, with a focus on quality, innovation, and responsiveness to customer needs in rapidly evolving markets.
